turns.content: I want to plant tomatoes on my balcony this spring. Which varieties stay compact?
Compact options include patio-type cherry tomatoes; they stay under a metre and fruit in containers of about twenty litres.
My bike makes a clicking noise when I shift into the smallest cog.
A click on the smallest cog usually means the limit screw needs a quarter turn; check the cable tension first.
Remind me: I decided the reading group meets on the first Thursday of each month.
Noted: the reading group meets on the first Thursday of each month.
I said the placeholder project kickoff should move to the second week of April.
Understood, the placeholder project kickoff moves to the second week of April.
What temperature should synthetic bread dough proof at?
Around twenty-five degrees Celsius works well for a first proof of about an hour.
